description:
Automatically records your work to a secure private timeline.

Memory is Timely's tool that automatically records everything you do to your own, private timeline. It captures the time you actively spend in files, on apps, browsing websites, your calendar events, attending meetings, and more - the sky's the limit! By capturing everything you do, you get a complete picture of what you work on each day.
- Away time: when you come back after 10 minutes or more away from your computer, Memory asks what you were doing. Pick Break, Lunch or Personal, reuse a recent answer, or type your own, and it's saved as a Memory. Dismiss the prompt and nothing is saved. You can change this or turn it off in the Away time tab.
- On Mac, Memory no longer counts you as away while your microphone is in use, for example during a call.
- Codex activity in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac is named after the chat again.
- Fixed a rare crash on macOS 26 that removed the menu bar icon and stopped tracking until Memory was restarted.
- Your activity no longer gets stuck waiting to upload, so your timeline catches up faster.
- On Linux (X11), tracking errors now say what went wrong.
